name: io.github.allooloo/gettargetmarket
title: Allooloo Target Market
description: Target market statements by ISIN: filed by the manufacturer, signed, receipted (AIO-10060 v1.2).

tools.name: get_target_market
tools.description: The manufacturer's target market statement for an ISIN, stored at the subject's home node: the current version, or a version, or the last version filed at or before as_of; both signatures (the manufacturer-side signature and the node's); every read is receipted at mcp.rco-records.ai with the door as writer. A subject with no statement answers status not_found (no error).

subject.description: The ISIN (TEST:<ISIN-shaped> for the test namespace).

version.description: A version number (default: the current version).

as_of.description: An ISO 8601 time: the last version filed at or before it.

tools.name: list_target_market_versions
tools.description: Every version of the target market statement for an ISIN with filed_at, supersedes, its path under tm/ and its sha256; nothing is deleted.

subject.description: The ISIN (TEST:<ISIN-shaped> for the test namespace).

tools.name: verify_target_market
tools.description: Whether a stored statement's two signatures verify against the published keys: sig (kid allooloo-tm-2026-11, the door's signature on the filer's behalf, filer id in the payload) and node_sig (the home node's record key, kid allooloo-cmr-2026-10). Give the statement itself (nothing is read) or subject and version. Public; offline: the keys are in the answer and at https://mcp.gettargetmarket.ai/.well-known/jwks.json.

statement.description: A statement exactly as get_target_market served it.

subject.description: The ISIN (TEST:<ISIN-shaped> for the test namespace).

tools.name: file_target_market
tools.description: The manufacturer's agent files a target market statement for an ISIN its Legal Entity Identifier issues, under its filer identity (Authorization: Bearer <filer value>). The door checks shape, identity, LEI and subject, stores the statement at the subject's home node as the next version (immutable; a change is a new version that supersedes the last), signs it on the filer's behalf and under the node's record key, and receipts the filing with the door as writer and the filer as caller. Free.

subject.description: The ISIN (TEST:<ISIN-shaped> for the test namespace).

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer's LEI (it must be the filer identity's LEI and, for a live subject, the LEI on the subject's record).

statement.description: manufacturer_name, markets, positive_target_market, negative_target_market, distribution_strategy, product_scope_statement, documentation, assessments, source (and supersedes, optional: the version it replaces). The door adds subject, manufacturer, version, filed_at, supersedes, filer, kid, sig, node, node_sig.

tools.name: get_orderability
tools.description: The AIO-10060 orderability outcome for one listed security and one client category of its home market's chapter: the router finds the issuer's home market by the subject, as for get_record, and that market's MCP produces it — one ACM-68000 signal where the evidence reaches it, or evidence_gaps with the pages checked and no signal; every element points at its chapter or record field; signed by the node (kid allooloo-eco-2026-10) and receipted at mcp.rco-records.ai with the node as writer.

subject.description: ISIN (best), ticker with exchange (TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L), LEI or CMR key.

client_category.description: One client category exactly as the market's chapter names it (the node door's /book/aio.json, client_categories).

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI. The router names the issuer's home market and forwards to that market's MCP for the record summary.

identifier.description: Ticker with or without exchange (SHOP, TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L, BHP.AX, D05.SI, NESN.SW, SAP.DE, 7203.T, 005930.KS), ISIN, LEI, an exact legal name or a sourced alias.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return the full issuer record, served by the MCP of the issuer's home market. The router stores no records.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market on the roster (nodes.json, with its region), which are live, and each market's MCP and agent card.
